lines.say: Myth: one big Sunday session covers the whole week.
Be honest. It turns into a long scroll.
And one topic, if you're lucky.
Fact: short sessions across the week stick better.
Especially when you test yourself from memory.
Offload builds your plan from your notes and exam dates.
If you miss an evening, it moves.
It tests you as you go.
And brings topics back before you forget them.
You just click the link in your calendar and show up.
